title: 1-Wire: the DS18B20 temperature sensor

spans.text: 1-Wire connects compatible devices on one bus with few wires. DS18B20 measures temperature digitally and has a unique identifier. The data line needs a suitable pull-up; wiring and power matter on long cables.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Install the OneWire and DallasTemperature libraries. The example checks `DEVICE_DISCONNECTED_C`; parasite-power mode changes conversion timing and wiring, so follow the sensor datasheet.

visual_description: Add a wiring schematic and pin map showing board pins, VCC/GND, and signal direction; include a memory or task-state diagram where relevant.
